decisions.reason: ACE3 was publicly launched as the firm's new industry-standard distributed ALCMS control solution, builds directly on its core airfield lighting business, and fits the announced move toward integrated, automated airport operations, so the investment and visible commitment strongly favor keeping it.

The air situation display extends the firm's established tower and surveillance offering and supports its integrated, real-time information-sharing strategy; only one year after launch, any weak results can still be put down to long airport procurement cycles, so management would persist.
